1.listing_title: Modern Beachside Retreat with Stunning City Views
highlights: Steps away from the beach for sun-soaked days
Spacious home accommodating up to 6 guests
Bright, cozy bedrooms with breathtaking city views
Inviting living room with projector for movie nights
Modern minimalist design for a serene escape
1.full_description:
Welcome to your modern beachside retreat, a beautifully designed house perfect for families or friends seeking a serene getaway. With three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, this home comfortably accommodates up to six guests, making it an ideal choice for your next vacation. The property is just a short stroll from the beach, allowing you to bask in the sun and enjoy the gentle ocean breeze at your leisure.

Step inside and be greeted by warm, inviting spaces adorned with modern minimalist furnishings and a soothing neutral color palette. Each bedroom features large windows that flood the rooms with natural light and offer stunning views of the cityscape. Relax in the cozy corner seating areas, where you can unwind with a good book or simply take in the beauty surrounding you. The high-quality bedding ensures a restful night’s sleep, so you wake up refreshed and ready for a day of adventure.

The heart of the home is the inviting living room, designed for both relaxation and entertainment. With warm ambient lighting and comfortable seating, it’s the perfect spot to gather with loved ones. Enjoy movie nights with the projector screen, creating a cinematic experience right at home. The seamless flow from the living area to the bedrooms allows for both togetherness and privacy, catering to all your needs during your stay.

Please note, this property is not pet-friendly, ensuring a clean and allergen-free environment for guests. Experience a blend of modern comfort and coastal charm at this stunning beachside home, where every detail is curated for your enjoyment. Book your stay today and create unforgettable memories by the sea!
